content: 303 of 535 Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R20-11 Name Dem_IumprDenomCondStatusType Kind Type Derived from uint8 DEM_IUMPR_DEN_STATUS_ NOT_REACHED 0x00 Condition of IUMPR-Denominator given by IUMPRDenCondId is not met (yet). DEM_IUMPR_DEN_STATUS_ REACHED 0x01 Condition of IUMPR-Denominator given by IUMPRDenCondId is met DEM_IUMPR_DEN_STATUS_ INHIBITED 0x02 Condition of IUMPR-Denominator given by IUMPRDenCondId is inhibited and cannot be reached. Range 0x03 - 0xFF reserved Description This type contains all possible states of an additional IUMPR denominator condition to be broadcasted among OBD-relevant ECUs. Variation  Available via Rte_Dem_Type.h
